+import re
+from rich.ansi import re_ansi
+
+test_cases = [
+    (r"Hello\x1b0World", "HelloWorld"),
+    (r"Hello\x1b?World", "HelloWorld"),
+    (r"Hello\x1b[31mRed\x1b[0mWorld", "HelloRedWorld"),
+    (r"Hello\x1b]8;;http://example.com\x1b\\Link\x1b]8;;\x1b\\World", "HelloLinkWorld"),
+]
+
+for input_str, expected in test_cases:
+    # We want to see if re_ansi matches the problematic sequences
+    # In the current implementation, if it's matched, it's either stripped or handled.
+    # To verify the regex, we can just check if it matches.
+    matches = re_ansi.findall(input_str)
+    print(f"Input: {repr(input_str)} | Matches: {matches}")
+
+# Specifically check for \x1b0 and \x1b?
+assert re_ansi.search(r"\x1b0") is not None, "Failed to match \x1b0"
+assert re_ansi.search(r"\x1b?") is not None, "Failed to match \x1b?"
+print("All tests passed!")
